Static Definitions Summary


Enumerations

  • Grade - Item grade. Deliberately omits a zero entry.
  • SkillType - Declared in snake_case on purpose.
  • ValueType - Value types used by the test tables.

Tables

  • ArrayTypes - One cell holding several delimited values, length varying per row.
  • Item - References ItemCategory by record.
  • ItemCategory - Referenced by Item.CategoryId.
  • Localization - Trailing-number columns collapse into arrays.
  • ServerTuning - Server-only table. Must not appear in client output.
  • TestFieldTypes - One column per supported primitive type.

ConstantSets

  • GameConfig - Assorted tuning constants.
